title: UI polish for Drawer header stepper button, Kanban card footer, ThinkingCard whitespace, ToolExecutionCard failed edit badge, and live stage timers
commitMessage: feat(ui): polish cards and drawer components
author: agent-developer (react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Resolved 5 high-visibility UI issues across Drawer and Kanban cards: 1) Replaced obsidian black button in DrawerHeader stage stepper with White Paper / Vercel style (bg-[#f4f4f5] border border-[#ebebeb] text-[#171717] font-semibold shadow-2xs); 2) Removed literal 'модель не задана' in KanbanCard footer and conditionally rendered model only when non-empty; 3) Stripped trailing newlines with visibleText.trimEnd() and reduced bottom padding in ThinkingCard; 4) Added subtle red FAILED EDIT badge and contextualized diff label as 'Запланированные изменения (не применены)' for failed tool executions in ToolExecutionCard; 5) Dynamically calculated live stage duration and total elapsed timers in KanbanCard and boardStore from stageEnteredAt || updatedAt || createdAt with state preservation on disk resync, and implemented seamless s/m/h/d formatStageDuration formatting.
